quests.title: The middle of a short corridor
quests.ask: In a five-cell corridor there is exactly one middle cell. Put the gem there.
quests.nudge: How long is the list `scan()` gives here? How many of those cells lie between you and the middle?

quests.title: Two middles: the nearer one
quests.ask: An eight-cell corridor has two middle cells. Put the gem on the one nearer to you.
quests.nudge: Does `scan()` count the cell you're standing on? Draw the corridor and count.

quests.title: A corridor of one cell
quests.ask: In a corridor one cell long, the wall is right in front of you. Put the gem on the middle cell.
quests.nudge: What does `scan()` give back when there's nothing ahead? How long is that list?
